exports.name: BreadcrumbComponent
exports.summary: A single crumb item rendered inside {@link BreadcrumbsComponent}.
exports.summaryZh: {@link BreadcrumbsComponent} 内渲染的单个面包屑项。

properties.name: matButtonClass
properties.descriptionZh: 内部使用，始终为 `true`，用于绑定 Material 按钮宿主类名。

properties.name: tdBreadCrumbClass
properties.description: Host binding `tdBreadCrumbClass` bound to host attribute/property `class.dui-breadcrumb` for td bread crumb class.
properties.descriptionZh: 内部使用，始终为 `true`，用于绑定 `dui-breadcrumb` 宿主类名。

properties.name: separatorIcon
properties.description:
The Material icon name shown as the separator after this crumb. Set by the parent
{@link BreadcrumbsComponent}. Defaults to `chevron_right`.
properties.descriptionZh:
显示在本面包屑项之后的分隔符 Material 图标名称，由父级 {@link BreadcrumbsComponent} 设置，
默认为 `chevron_right`。

properties.name: separatorIcon
properties.description:
The Material icon name shown as the separator after this crumb. Set by the parent
{@link BreadcrumbsComponent}. Defaults to `chevron_right`.
properties.descriptionZh:
显示在本面包屑项之后的分隔符 Material 图标名称，由父级 {@link BreadcrumbsComponent} 设置，
默认为 `chevron_right`。

properties.name: displayIcon
properties.description: Whether the separator icon is shown after this crumb (`false` for the last crumb).
properties.descriptionZh: 是否在本面包屑项之后显示分隔符图标（最后一项为 `false`）。

properties.name: displayIcon
properties.description: Whether the separator icon is shown after this crumb (`false` for the last crumb).
properties.descriptionZh: 是否在本面包屑项之后显示分隔符图标（最后一项为 `false`）。

properties.name: displayCrumb
properties.description:
Whether this crumb is currently displayed (set to `false` by the parent when it no longer
fits the available width).
properties.descriptionZh: 本面包屑项当前是否显示（当父容器宽度不足时会被父级设置为 `false`）。

properties.name: displayCrumb
properties.description:
Whether this crumb is currently displayed (set to `false` by the parent when it no longer
fits the available width).
properties.descriptionZh: 本面包屑项当前是否显示（当父容器宽度不足时会被父级设置为 `false`）。

properties.name: width
properties.description: The crumb's rendered width in pixels, measured after view init.
properties.descriptionZh: 面包屑项渲染后的宽度（像素），在视图初始化后测量得出。

properties.name: displayBinding
properties.descriptionZh: 内部使用，绑定宿主的 `display` 样式，隐藏时设置为 `'none'`。

exports.name: BreadcrumbsComponent
exports.summary:
Container for {@link BreadcrumbComponent} items; automatically collapses/hides crumbs that
no longer fit the available width on resize.
exports.summaryZh: {@link BreadcrumbComponent} 面包屑项的容器；在窗口尺寸变化时自动折叠/隐藏放不下的面包屑项。

inputs.name: separatorIcon
inputs.description: The Material icon name used as the separator between breadcrumb items. Defaults to `chevron_right`.
inputs.descriptionZh: 用作面包屑项之间分隔符的 Material 图标名称，默认为 `chevron_right`。

properties.name: tdBreadCrumbsClass
properties.description: Host binding `tdBreadCrumbsClass` bound to host attribute/property `class.dui-breadcrumbs` for td bread crumbs class.
properties.descriptionZh: 内部使用，始终为 `true`，用于绑定 `dui-breadcrumbs` 宿主类名。

properties.name: hiddenBreadcrumbs
properties.description: The child breadcrumbs currently hidden because they don't fit the available width.
properties.descriptionZh: 因宽度不足而当前被隐藏的子面包屑项。

properties.name: separatorIcon
properties.description: The Material icon name used as the separator between breadcrumb items. Defaults to `chevron_right`.
properties.descriptionZh: 用作面包屑项之间分隔符的 Material 图标名称，默认为 `chevron_right`。

properties.name: nativeElementWidth
properties.description: The host element's content-box width (outer width minus border/margin/padding).
properties.descriptionZh: 宿主元素的内容区宽度（外部宽度减去边框/外边距/内边距）。

properties.name: count
properties.description: The number of projected breadcrumb items.

exports.name: BreadcrumbsModule
exports.summary: Angular module `BreadcrumbsModule` declaring and exporting breadcrumbs module components, directives, pipes, and providers.
exports.summaryZh: Angular 模块 `BreadcrumbsModule`，声明并导出面包屑导航模块相关的组件、指令、管道与服务提供者。
